_comment: Product art on a transparent background, for the Printify path. A white rectangle behind a design prints as a white rectangle on the shirt, so this is not cosmetic. Generated on a flat backdrop the matte can actually find, then cut out — ImageRemoveBackground is a custom node (rembg), and the registry checks the server has it before choosing this graph rather than failing with an unreadable node error.

inputs.text: __PROMPT__, isolated on a plain flat white background, no scenery, no shadow
__NEGATIVE__, busy background, gradient background, drop shadow
